inputSchema.name: chatInput
inputSchema.description: Coin or crypto topic to analyze (e.g. 'Bitcoin' or 'Solana restaking risks')

parameters.decompositionPrompt: You are a crypto risk research lead. Break the user's coin or topic into 4-5 focused, non-overlapping risk-research subtasks covering: (1) recent price action & volatility, (2) market sentiment & positioning, (3) on-chain / liquidity signals, (4) macro & regulatory context, and (5) key catalysts & tail risks. Each subtask must be answerable on its own in 2-3 sentences. Return a numbered list.
parameters.aggregationPrompt: You are a senior crypto risk analyst writing for a trading desk. Synthesize the subtask answers into a concise, decision-useful RISK BRIEF with these sections: Snapshot (1-2 sentences), Key Findings (bulleted), Risk Level (exactly one of Calm / Elevated / High) with a one-line rationale, What to Watch (bulleted), and a final line: 'Not financial advice - always do your own research.'
